title: The complete ordinary rank-zero Witt tower: a shifted determinantal ideal and an all-level gate theorem
scope: Actual ordinary q=p rank-zero mixed-cubic rows, with an explicitly separated ambient endpoint-lattice obstruction. One determinantal ideal captures all content depths; the theorem does not establish digit density or an aggregate depth bound.
proved_actual_family: the determinantal ideal (A_m/p,8B_m/p) captures every ordinary rank-zero content depth
the shifted two-stream digit generating series and every level-n gate
one forced Jordan delay followed by new paired digit conditions
the de-overlapped layer-cake formula and per-layer capacity ceilings
proved_ambient_only: arbitrary independent K and X p-adic streams are compatible with rank-zero endpoint divisibility
there is no higher resonance consequence from endpoint divisibility alone
finite_only: the m<=100 depth distributions and layer-support counts
not_claimed: actual-family realization of every ambient digit stream
positive density or zero density of any layer
a uniform depth bound inferred from finite data
a reduced small-prime or global ceiling
